Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_cnt NUMBER;
begin
 if :ctrl_block.country is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 select count(*) into v_cnt
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'CNTRY' 
 and UPPER(description) = UPPER(TRIM(:ctrl_block.country))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1); 
 
 if v_cnt = 0 then
 begin
 -- Check if entered value is country code
 select description into :ctrl_block.country
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'CNTRY' 
 and UPPER(code) = UPPER(TRIM(:ctrl_block.country))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) and rownum < 2; 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1809');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EMAIL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_email(email_addr_in in varchar2) IS
 l_dot_pos NUMBER;
 l_at_pos NUMBER;
 l_str_length NUMBER;
 l_email_addr varchar2(150);
 v_temp VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 l_email_addr := email_addr_in;
 l_dot_pos := instr(l_email_addr,'.');
 l_at_pos := instr(l_email_addr,'@');
 l_str_length := length(l_email_addr);
 IF ((l_dot_pos = 0) OR (l_at_pos = 0) OR (l_dot_pos = l_at_pos + 1) OR
 (l_at_pos = 1) OR (l_at_pos = l_str_length) OR
 (l_dot_pos = l_str_length))
 THEN
 show_error('16189');
 END IF;
 IF instr(substr(l_email_addr,l_at_pos),'.') = 0
 THEN
 show_error('16189'); 
 END IF;
 
 v_temp := ltrim('@', substr(l_email_addr, instr(l_email_addr, '@')+1));
 
 if v_temp is null then
 show_error('16189');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 
END validate_email;
